sources.title: Open Problems in Affine Differential Geometry and Related Topics
sources.inspection: Full three-page PDF obtained. Original item 1(a), its footnote, and bibliography visually inspected on printed pages 125-127; no completeness, global dual-chart, convex-domain, or fixed-dimension condition stated.

sources.title: The Bonnet theorem for statistical manifolds
sources.inspection: Full PDF obtained and text inspected: introduction, definitions in Sections 2.1-2.4, local embedding equivalence and potential extension. Uses Riemannian metric, torsion-free connection, positive Hessian, and local affine coordinates.

sources.title: Monotone invariants and embeddings of statistical manifolds
sources.inspection: Full 23-page PDF obtained; abstract, statistical definitions, Theorems 5.1 and 5.6 and associated proof passages inspected. Version history expressly adds compactness to Main Theorem and Theorem 5.6.

sources.title: C1-statistical manifolds are statistical models
sources.inspection: Full historical preprint obtained and read. This is not the final Journal of Geometry full text. Its broad noncompact claim is not used as a theorem in the proof.

sources.title: Differentiable Manifolds
sources.inspection: Full 37-page scanned PDF obtained. Printed pages 646-647, 652-653 and 665 visually inspected, including Lemma 19, footnote 32 properness, and the normal-neighborhood discussion. The standard smooth proper-embedding and tubular-neighborhood theorems are declared dependencies.

sources.title: Statistical manifolds are statistical models
sources.inspection: Publisher abstract and metadata inspected. Final full journal article not obtained. Abstract alone is not used for noncompact realization.
